title: A time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in the AMD SEV Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware…
description: CVE-2025-54506 is a time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability in the AMD SEV Secure Encrypted Virtualization firmware. This flaw could allow an attacker with administrative privileges to bypass security checks on scatter lists, potentially compromising guest integrity. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating and no known exploits in the wild. No affected versions or patch information are currently provided.
